user.title: Connect De’Longhi Account
user.description: Enter your De’Longhi (My Coffee Lounge) credentials to discover your smart appliances.

data_description.device_ip: The local network IP address of your coffee machine for instantaneous, zero-cloud latency control.

select_device.title: Select Appliance
select_device.description: Multiple coffee machines were found linked to your account. Choose the appliance you wish to configure.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: De’Longhi no longer accepts the saved password for {username}. Enter your current My Coffee Lounge password to reconnect {name}.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid email or password. Please verify your credentials and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to De’Longhi cloud services. Please check your network connection.
error.no_devices: No smart coffee machines found linked to this De’Longhi account.
error.unknown: De’Longhi’s sign-in service gave an unexpected answer. Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, the Home Assistant log has the details.
error.device_not_on_account: This coffee machine is no longer linked to {username}. Check that it still appears in the My Coffee Lounge app.
error.account_locked: De’Longhi has paused sign-ins for this account after too many attempts. Sign in once in the My Coffee Lounge app, then try again in a few minutes.

abort.already_configured: This coffee machine is already configured in Home Assistant.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in. Your coffee machine is reconnected.

init.title: Appliance Settings
init.description: Adjust local network connectivity and cloud update polling interval.

data_description.device_ip: The local network IP address of your coffee machine.
data_description.poll_interval: How frequently to refresh appliance status from De’Longhi cloud services.

command_no_local_address.message: Add your coffee machine’s IP address in the integration’s options to control it.

command_not_connected.message: Not connected to the coffee machine on your home network. Check that it’s plugged in and on Wi-Fi.

command_rejected.message: The coffee machine declined. It may be busy or already in that state.

command_unauthorized.message: The coffee machine refused the connection. Try again in a moment.

command_no_reply.message: The coffee machine didn’t answer. Check that it’s on and connected to Wi-Fi.

command_connection_lost.message: The connection to the coffee machine dropped. Try again in a moment.
